description: breast sentinel node, micrometastasis by size, no extranodal extension
report:
Lymph node, left SLN1, sentinel lymph node biopsy

Received in formalin is a piece of fibroadipose tissue containing one lymph node. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Lymph node, bisected.

Sections show fibroadipose tissue and one lymph node. The lymph node is involved by metastatic carcinoma, the largest deposit measuring 1.2 mm (micrometastasis). There is no extranodal extension. The tumour cells are highlighted by immunostain for pancytokeratin AE1/AE3.

LYMPH NODE, left SLN1, sentinel lymph node biopsy - METASTATIC CARCINOMA (1/1); largest deposit 1.2 mm (micrometastasis); no extranodal extension
